table.title: [Ships of the Chinese Navy, by Squadron]
table.caption_extra: Grouping of Ships. The lists appended show the grouping of the vessels of the Chinese Navy prior to the outbreak of Sino-Japanese hostilities. After the outbreak a number of Chinese warships were sunk in the Yangtze, and at Ningpo, Canton, Tsingtao and other ports, to block the fairways, and an unknown number were damaged or sunk by Japanese aircraft. In addition to the ships listed in these tables there are a number of small gunboats belonging to various provinces, the whereabouts and condition of which are unknown.
